summary:
ITER 184b — Frontend-only retest + verification of Pros & Cons Step 8/Step 5/Step 4 features against seeded analysis 98426703-317e-4083-bcfd-bbfa0444da69 (super@test.com, mobile 390x844). ALL 7 review items PASS.

(1) RETEST — Step 8 crash FIXED: pros-cons-wizard.tsx now defines sectionPctByOptC1 alongside sectionPctByOpt (lines 1870-1888). Step 8 renders without ReferenceError. The 'Overall score per option (Case-2 / MPPS)' card shows a comparison TABLE with header row METRIC / CASE-1 / CASE-2 / CHANGE and rows 'Overall %', 'Score', 'Mandatory %', 'Optional %' (NOT 'A %'/'B %'). Delta arrows (▲/▼) render, zero delta shows a dim '0.0'. Verified via DOM inner-text scan: hasMetric=T, hasCase1=T, hasCase2=T, hasChange=T, hasOverallPct=T, hasScoreRow=T, hasMandatoryPct=T, hasOptionalPct=T, hasAPct=F, hasBPct=F.

(2) RETEST — Step 4 sub-factor chip title tooltip FIXED: components.tsx wraps each candidate-child chip in a WebTitle React.createElement('div',{title,style}) on Platform.OS==='web'. After tapping '+ Sub-factor' on TEST_Salary, document.querySelectorAll('[title]').length === 2 with titles equal to the FULL untruncated names ('TEST_Commute time', 'TEST_Growth potential'). ✓

(3) NEW — Step 8 Type chips: labelled 'Quantitative' and 'Qualitative' (verified 3 quant + 3 qual leaf nodes; 0 'Subjective', 0 'Objective'). Preselection reflects Step-5 type: Factor 1 (seeded quantitative) shows Quantitative highlighted; Factors 2 & 3 (set to Qualitative in Step 5 during this run) show Qualitative highlighted. Tapping toggles between the two — verified by watching background flip between rgb(99,102,241) (on) and rgb(248,250,252) (off). ✓

(4) NEW — '|' separator between Type and Improvability groups is present (verified: a leaf element with textContent === '|' exists on each factor card). ✓

(5) NEW — Improvability multi-select: default 'Not improvable' is highlighted (indigo). Tapping 'Improvable' → Improvable ON, Not improvable OFF, Improvable (self) OFF. Tapping 'Improvable (self)' → BOTH 'Improvable' AND 'Improvable (self)' highlighted simultaneously (multi-select). After page reload the y_both value persists (both chips still highlighted on factor 1). Tapping 'Not improvable' clears the other two and highlights only 'Not improvable'. ✓

(6) NEW — Per-option improvement-row names render fully: Factor cards show 'TEST_Option Alpha - a very long option name that must wrap properly on step 7 without ellipsis' and 'TEST_Option Beta - another very long option name to verify no truncation on wizard' on multiple lines (assessOpt style: width:'100%'). ✓

(7) NEW — Step 5 operator chip row is shared across factor types: DOM scan shows each of the 11 operators — ≥ ≤ > < = ≠ Contains, Starts with, Ends with, Equals, Not equals — appearing exactly 3 times (once per factor, including quant AND qual factors). Screenshot confirms TEST_Salary (Quantitative) row displays ALL operators including 'Contains'/'Starts with'/'Ends with'/'Equals'/'Not equals'. ✓

No runtime errors on Step 4/5/8. Ambient RN-Web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents, expo-notifications) unchanged from prior iterations — pre-existing/informational only.

react_native_issues.issue: Chronic '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — pre-existing warning, not introduced this iteration.
Chronic 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — pre-existing.
Chronic '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web.' — informational.

critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/tools/pros-cons-wizard.tsx:1870-1888 — sectionPctByOptC1 now built alongside sectionPctByOpt using calcPct(...,false) baseline. Clean fix; delta rendering guards with (v===null ? '—' : ...) so empty-section cases don't NaN.

/app/frontend/src/features/pros-cons/components.tsx:15-18 — WebTitle wrapper uses React.createElement('div',{title,style:{display:'inline-flex',maxWidth:'100%'}}) on Platform.OS==='web' — this is the correct approach because RN-Web strips unknown props from View/TouchableOpacity. Verified 2 title attributes on DOM after opening +Sub-factor.

/app/frontend/src/features/pros-cons/components.tsx:758-797 — FactorAssessmentCard type/separator/improvability block is well structured. combine() helper (y && bf → 'y_both') and per-chip toggle handlers correctly implement the multi-select spec. Persistence verified via reload.

/app/frontend/src/features/pros-cons/components.tsx:312 (FactorMetaControls) uses ALL_OPERATORS uniformly for every factor — matches spec that ALL operators (numeric + text) show for both Qualitative and Quantitative factors. Confirmed by 3 occurrences of each of the 11 operators on Step 5.
/app/frontend/src/features/pros-cons/styles.ts:368 — assessOpt uses width:'100%' + marginBottom:2 so long option names wrap to their own line above the Improvement% row. Good.
seed_data_creation: Reused seeded Pros & Cons analysis 98426703-317e-4083-bcfd-bbfa0444da69 from iter181 (3 factors: TEST_Salary=mandatory, TEST_Commute time=optional, TEST_Growth potential=optional; 2 options TEST_Option Alpha…/TEST_Option Beta… with intentionally long names). Interactive taps this iteration changed factor 1's improvability to y_both (verified persisted after reload) and back to n; factor 1 type toggled Quant→Qual→Quant. Factors 2 & 3 currently persisted as Qualitative from an incidental tap during type-toggle exploration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter184b Pros & Cons items pass on 98426703-317e-4083-bcfd-bbfa0444da69. Sign in via UI (super@test.com / SuperPass2026!) then navigate to /tools/pros-cons-wizard?id={analysisId}. When testing chip states, walk up from the leaf Text (children.length===0) to the ancestor with role='button' and read getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor — indigo rgb(99,102,241) means on, near-white rgb(248,250,252) means off. Improvability persistence: 'y_both' string is round-tripped via PUT /api/pros-cons/{id}/factors/{fid}. Step-5 operator chips are common to both types via ALL_OPERATORS (decisionHelpers.ts:63). If Factor 2 or 3 are still qualitative from this run, flipping them Quantitative in Step 5 also flips the Step-8 preselection because Step 8 reads factor.data_type/factor_type.
